digest.component_or_area: Git repository history rewrite operational script
propositions: Build and validate a one-time history-strip script using stock Git plumbing (fast-export/fast-import) that removes .bridge_state/ and .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ from all historical revisions while preserving DAG topology, merge commits, and empty commits.

Prove the rewrite on a fresh unfiltered --no-tags scratch clone, asserting commit/merge-commit counts are unchanged, rewritten tree equals original tree after dynamic re-add, and packed size is under 150 MB.

The script must refuse to run on partial (blob:none) clones and dynamically derive the re-add set from git ls-tree rather than hardcoded lists, parsing data blocks by byte length to handle commit messages that begin with file-command prefixes.

The dry-run script must perform no remote push, leave source remote refs (tickets branch and pre-heal tag) unchanged, assert the protected tag is absent from the local scratch clone before pack measurement, and emit final success only after all assertions pass.

Validate with unit tests for binary stream filtering (adversarial message framing) and integration tests for multi-repository DAG/tree/history/reachability/pack-size assertions and representative post-rewrite writer push behavior.
